title: Reference J.M. DaSilva DAquino And Maitland An Co., Ltd

page_data.en:
Special Affairs Section
Reference J.M. D'Aquino Maitland & Co. Ltd.
（印：Sp. Br. Libry. No. U. 6244 Date. 16-12-44 November 22nd, 1944.）

Name. Jose Maria da Silva Souza.
Address. Lane 117, House No.2 Avenue Haig. French District.
Birth. Born on September 26th, 1891 in Shanghai of Portuguese parents.
Passport. Holds Portuguese Passport No. 339, issued by the Portuguese Consul-General in Shanghai, dated 21st August, 1915.
Resident Certificate No. F. 5234.
Occupation. Accountant.
History. Received his education at the St. Francis Xavier College in Shanghai.
Has worked in various capacities in Import and Export concerns, General Merchants etc till the 1930's. Joined Messrs. Maitland & Co., Ltd. Lane 126, House 10 Szechuen Road, held position as accountant till the outbreak of the present hostilities, at present still employed with this firm.
Married, but has separated from his wife for many years One son who is, at present, under the guardianship of his wife.
He mixes with Portuguese and Russian circles and is well-known among the former social sphere. He is a member of the Clube Lusitano, Portuguese Social Club.
There is nothing detrimental to his character in Police records and neither among Portuguese official circles.

....................................................................

Name. Messrs. Maitland & Co., Ltd.
Address. Lane 126, House No. 10 Szechuen Road.
Nationality. Registered as a British Firm.
Manager. Mr. A.M. Corbett. Britisher, at present interned in the Civil Assembly Center in Pootung. Classification No. P. 7/99 with his wife.
Business. General Merchants, Import & Exporters
Agents for a. Builders Supplies
b. Atlas - Chemical and Industrial Works.
c. Sanitary Fixtures
Acts as General Managers for H.C. Dixon & Son, Ltd.
This Company's representative, Mr. A.M. Dixon, Britisher signs P.P. (Per Proprietor) for this concern. Dixon is also interned in a Civil Assembly Center in Pootung under Classification No. P. 141.

Present Standing and Activities. Since the taking over of Enemy Concerns, Maitland & Co. has been under the Supervision of the Japanese Military Trustee : The Shanghai Soko Shinku K.K. (The Shanghai Warehousing & Trust Co). Head Supervisor being Mr. S. Suzuki. The Company does not do any business at present. The Company derives an income from Rentals and Storage of Goods & Cargo in its properties, the Building at the above address being the Company's Property.

（签名）
C.A.
page_data.zh:
特别事务科
事由：J.M. D'Aquino 梅特兰有限公司（Maitland & Co. Ltd.）
（印章：特别处图书馆编号 U. 6244 日期 1944年12月16日 1944年11月22日。）

姓名：Jose Maria da Silva Souza。
地址：法租界海格路（Avenue Haig）117弄2号。
出生：1891年9月26日出生于上海，父母均为葡萄牙人。
护照：持有葡萄牙驻上海总领事馆于1915年8月21日签发的第339号葡萄牙护照。
居住证号码：F. 5234。
职业：会计师。
履历：在上海圣方济各沙勿略学院（St. Francis Xavier College）接受教育。
直至20世纪30年代，曾在各类进出口商行、综合商号等机构担任不同职务。后加入位于四川路126弄10号的梅特兰有限公司（Messrs. Maitland & Co., Ltd.），担任会计师一职，直至当前战事爆发，目前仍受雇于该公司。
已婚，但已与妻子分居多年。育有一子，目前由其妻子监护。
他与葡萄牙人和俄罗斯人圈子有交往，在前者社交圈中颇有名气。他是葡萄牙社交俱乐部“卢西塔诺俱乐部”（Clube Lusitano）的成员。
警方档案及葡萄牙官方圈子中均无对其品行不利的记录。

....................................................................

名称：梅特兰有限公司（Messrs. Maitland & Co., Ltd.）。
地址：四川路126弄10号。
国籍：注册为英国商行。
经理：A.M. Corbett 先生。英国人，目前被拘禁在浦东平民集合中心。与其妻子一同归类编号为 P. 7/99。
业务：综合商号，进出口商。
代理业务包括：a. 建筑用品；b. 阿特拉斯化学与工业制品厂（Atlas - Chemical and Industrial Works）；c. 卫生洁具。
兼任 H.C. Dixon & Son, Ltd. 的总经理。
该公司的代表 A.M. Dixon 先生（英国人）代表该企业签署“P.P.”（Per Proprietor，即代表业主）。Dixon 也被拘禁在浦东的一个平民集合中心，归类编号为 P. 141。

现状与活动：自敌产被接管以来，梅特兰有限公司一直处于日本军方受托人——上海仓库信托株式会社（The Shanghai Soko Shinku K.K.，即上海仓储信托公司）的监管之下。总监为 S. Suzuki 先生。该公司目前未开展任何业务。公司收入来源于其物业的租金以及货物和 cargo 的仓储费，上述地址的建筑物为公司所有财产。

（签名）
C.A.
